source_definitions.mysql:
CREATE VIEW vw_claim_dashboard AS
SELECT
    c.claim_id,
    c.claim_no,
    c.patient_id,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name) AS patient_name,
    ic.company_name AS insurance_company,
    t.tpa_name,
    ip.policy_number,
    c.claim_type,
    c.claim_stage,
    c.claim_status,
    c.estimated_amount,
    c.claimed_amount,
    c.approved_amount,
    c.patient_payable_amount,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at
FROM claims c
JOIN patients p ON p.patient_id = c.patient_id
JOIN patient_insurance pi ON pi.patient_insurance_id = c.patient_insurance_id
JOIN insurance_policies pol ON pol.policy_id = pi.policy_id
JOIN insurance_companies ic ON ic.insurance_company_id = pol.insurance_company_id
LEFT JOIN tpas t ON t.tpa_id = pol.tpa_id;

CREATE VIEW vw_claim_type_summary AS
SELECT claim_type, COUNT(*) AS total_claims,
       COALESCE(SUM(claimed_amount),0) AS claimed_amount,
       COALESCE(SUM(approved_amount),0) AS approved_amount
FROM claims
GROUP BY claim_type;

tenant_transaction_strategy.context_source: Verified server session and current membership/capability lookup; never untrusted request fields alone
tenant_transaction_strategy.pooling_rule: BEGIN; parameterized set_config(name,value,true) / SET LOCAL on that transaction's connection; all ORM reads/writes inside it; COMMIT/ROLLBACK clears context
tenant_transaction_strategy.rls_rule: ENABLE and FORCE RLS on tenant operational tables; policies bind hospital, eligible branch and active grants with both USING and WITH CHECK; missing context denies access
tenant_transaction_strategy.threat_model_limit: Custom settings are not authentication. A compromised server/SQL execution role can change them; RLS is defense against accidental unscoped queries, not proof that an untrusted DB client is an authenticated staff member.
tenant_transaction_strategy.view_rule: security_invoker=true and underlying scoped RLS; include hospital/branch dimensions in summary groups; app views must never execute as migration owner
tenant_transaction_strategy.phase: foundation scoped keys in Phase 5; authenticated authorization/RLS enforcement and negative runtime tests in Phase 7
